summary: Verified redesigned /welcome screen (AzoApp) via Playwright on the external preview URL at 390x844. All required elements render, all testIDs found, navigation to /login and /register works with no crash/white-screen. No regressions in Login (mobile OTP) or Register (Partner/Merchant role cards) screens.

integration_issues.issue: CORS errors on requests to https://api.webhubmaster.shop/api/site/config and /api/notifications/push-config (No Access-Control-Allow-Origin). Not caused by the welcome redesign; pre-existing external backend config. Triggers 'No Internet Connection' modal on subsequent screens (e.g., Register). Consider fixing CORS on that backend or pointing REACT/EXPO env to a CORS-enabled endpoint.

action_items: (Out of scope but noticed) Fix CORS on api.webhubmaster.shop for /api/site/config and /api/notifications/push-config so downstream screens don't show the 'No Internet Connection' modal.
Minor: react-native-web deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted by welcome.tsx Image elements — move pointerEvents into style.
critical_code_review_comments: welcome.tsx uses `pointerEvents` as prop on <Image>; react-native-web is warning it's deprecated. Move to style.pointerEvents.
Language pill onPress is a no-op placeholder — acceptable for this iteration but should be wired to language selector later.
Registration/Login screens still trigger a global 'No Internet' modal due to CORS failures against api.webhubmaster.shop (pre-existing).
